description: Coin unit constants (ADR-068). Pinned by crates/amount, crates/api-gateway and the wallet; SDKs and docs must agree. There is no supply cap (ADR-046: MAX_SUPPLY = 2^256 - 1). halving_era_issuance is the sum of the mainnet schedule over the four halving eras (epochs 0..140256); at most that is paid, and the tail emission after it and the 7,000 coins of genesis validator bonds are separate figures.
